title: Balochistan Prevention of Gambling Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Prevention of Gambling Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXV OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXV OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
PREVENTION OF GAMBLING
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the
Balochistan Prevention
of
Gambling Ordinance, 1978
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
22nd
September, 2001]
No. Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑IV,
dated 22‑9‑2001.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made
by the Governor of Balochistan on 18th September, 2001 is hereby published for
general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Balochistan Prevention of Gambling (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force on the 14th day of August, 2001.
